name: facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.create_logger_instance: create a Logger instance with a model, scheduler, and checkpoint path for training logging
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.push_metrics_to_logger: push a dictionary of training metrics to the Logger for a specific task
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.update_logger_step: update the Logger step counter and print training status at the configured summary frequency
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.write_dict_to_tensorboard: write a dictionary of results directly to TensorBoard as scalar values at the current step
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.close_logger_writer: close the Logger TensorBoard SummaryWriter to flush and release resources

facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.compute_sequence_loss: compute the sequence loss over a list of flow predictions against ground truth flow with validity mask
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.calculate_epe_metrics: calculate end-point error metrics including 1px, 3px, and 5px thresholds from the final flow prediction
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.weight_iterative_predictions: weight iterative flow predictions using an adjusted loss gamma for consistent multi-iteration training
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.filter_invalid_flow_pixels: filter out invalid pixels and extremely large displacements from flow ground truth using magnitude threshold
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.validate_flow_tensor_shapes: validate that flow prediction tensors match ground truth shapes and contain no NaN or Inf values

facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.count_parameters_model: count the number of trainable parameters in a PyTorch model
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.run_test_eval_model: run test evaluation on a model across multiple dataloaders and save results to JSON
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.fig2data_matplotlib: convert a Matplotlib figure to a numpy array of RGB pixel values
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.save_ims_to_tb_tensorboard: save training images, disparity maps, and flow predictions to a TensorBoard writer
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/train_uti.review_utils_functions: review the utility functions for parameter counting, evaluation, figure conversion, and TensorBoard logging
